content.text: No MFN obligation burdens Customer; the only MFN runs in our favour.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Northwind. Section 12.3 expressly confirms that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer (or exclusivity/minimum-volume) commitment, and there is no right-to-match, best-terms disclosure, or third-party-offer mechanic anywhere in the document (Sections 2, 4, 7, 12, 23 and 30 reviewed). The only MFN-style provision, Section 7.6, runs in our favour ("Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms"), which is welcome under the rule and is not redlined. This meets the preferred position, so no change is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
